First call the go_column function with creates a binary indicator based on if a team goes for it or not.

Then verify that going for it does not result in any punts or field goals, just passes and rushes

Then filter out irrelavent plays

fourth_aug = go_column(data)
# no play represents timeouts and penalties
fourth_aug.groupby("go")["play_type"].value_counts().reset_index()
